title: Monotonicity of Bounded Halting
statement: Let $N$ be an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine, let $O$ be an oracle language, let $x$ be an input word, and let $t,t'$ be nonnegative integers. If every binary choice word of length $t$ makes the run of $N$ with oracle $O$, started on $x$, halt, and $t\le t'$, then every binary choice word of length $t'$ also makes that run halt.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle nondeterministic machine $N$ with $k$ ordinary work tapes
Every binary word of length $t$ yields a halted configuration
